intro: The environment: sorting rubbish, transport, habits at home. A practical topic for life in Poland — from your first week in a new flat you'll have to work out which bin is for what.
speaking.0.promptUa: Describe the illustration. Say where these people are, what they are doing and how they feel. Also say what you think will happen next.
speaking.0.phrases.0.ua: In the illustration I can see rubbish containers.
speaking.0.phrases.1.ua: The woman is sorting the waste.
speaking.0.phrases.3.ua: She's probably explaining the sorting rules to him.
speaking.0.tips.0: The colour of the bins matters: **żółty — plastik, niebieski — papier, zielony — szkło**. Use the colours in your description.
speaking.0.tips.1: **Dopiero się wprowadził** — «he only just moved in»: it explains why someone doesn't know the rules.
speaking.0.tips.2: A prediction at the end («będzie segregował prawidłowo») covers the «co dalej» point.
speaking.1.promptUa: Tell us what you do every day to look after the environment. Say what's easy for you and what's hard, and whether you would like to change anything.
speaking.1.phrases.1.ua: Easy for me is…, but hard is…
speaking.1.tips.0: The contrast **łatwe / trudne** gives a natural structure to the topic of habits.
speaking.1.tips.1: **Kiedy pogoda na to pozwala** — «when the weather allows»: a realistic detail rather than a perfect answer.
speaking.1.tips.2: Finish with a thought about meaning («małe nawyki mają znaczenie») — a nice philosophical ending.
speaking.2.promptUa: You call the housing cooperative because you don't know how to sort some waste, and you want to report that the bins are always full. Ask about the rules and report the problem.
speaking.2.phrases.0.ua: I would like to ask about the sorting rules.
speaking.2.phrases.1.ua: Where should I throw away used batteries?
speaking.2.phrases.3.ua: When do you collect the rubbish?
speaking.2.tips.0: **Nie pasują chyba do żadnego z tych pojemników** — a good way to phrase an unusual question.
speaking.2.tips.1: Everyday problems in Poland are usually solved by the **spółdzielnia** or the **zarządca** — remember this word.
speaking.2.tips.2: Finish with a specific request (harmonogram) — the conversation is brought to a practical result.
writing.0.promptUa: You want to start cycling to work instead of driving, but your bike is being repaired. Write a message to your neighbour: explain the situation and ask to borrow his bike for a week.
writing.0.phrases.0.ua: My bike is being repaired right now.
writing.0.phrases.1.ua: Could you lend me yours for a week?
writing.0.phrases.2.ua: Of course I'll return it in good condition.
writing.0.tips.0: **Zamiast samochodem** — «instead of by car»: instrumental with no preposition after «zamiast».
writing.0.tips.1: Offering something in return («coś w zamian») makes a request more polite.
writing.1.promptUa: There aren't enough rubbish bins in your area, so people leave litter on the street and in the park. Write an e-mail to the city council. Describe the problem, explain why it matters, and propose a solution.
writing.1.phrases.0.ua: I'm writing about the lack of rubbish bins in the area…
writing.1.phrases.1.ua: This problem affects the appearance and cleanliness of the area.
writing.1.phrases.2.ua: I propose installing additional bins near…
writing.1.phrases.3.ua: I would be grateful for a reply on this matter.
writing.1.tips.0: A citizen's complaint-proposal: **problem → why it matters → a concrete solution (number, place) → request for a reply**.
writing.1.tips.1: Give an exact number and place («co najmniej trzech… przy wejściu») — specifics are easier for an office to act on.
writing.1.tips.2: **Zniechęcają ludzi do + infinitive** — «discourage people from…»: a useful construction for argumentation.
listening.0.intro: Listen to the announcement about the clean-up day and answer the questions.
grammar.0.intro: Prepositions and verb forms in the topic of the environment.
grammar.0.questions.3.why: A parallel structure with the infinitive: «oddać…, a nie wyrzucać».
